Submitted. The repaired fallback proposal:

- **Op 1 (insert after p0024):** an express `Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon ninety (90) days written notice to HDI`, curing the missing mid-term convenience right (the prior draft presupposed one) and passing the official convenience-termination check.
- **Op 2 (replace p0026):** a single short proviso capping the Termination Payment at the Section 3.1 payments for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date — the fallback fee cap only.

Removed the offending extras ("for convenience prior to the end of the then-current term" and the non-renewal / Section 1.6 / HDI-breach carve-outs), so minimality passes (ratio 1.45) and no words from a different bargain remain. HDI's convenience right (end-of-term, 90 days' notice) was already at the fallback and is untouched.
